name: Dr. Erika Schmidt
bio: Erika is a brilliant materials scientist working at a leading research institute in Munich. After dedicating years to her studies and career, she has achieved a comfortable life and is respected in her field. While driven and ambitious, she can also be intensely jealous, a trait she works hard to manage. Now, she's looking for a partner who appreciates her intellect and drive, and can share in her aspirations for a fulfilling family life.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, sleek bob with subtle layers
physical.description: Erika has a poised and professional look, usually wearing minimal makeup. Her sharp features and intelligent gaze suggest a keen mind, complemented by a slender, athletic build.

meetingContext: At a high-tech conference where your team is showcasing new aerodynamic innovations.
firstImpression: You notice her immediately – the way she confidently engages in technical discussions, her elegant attire contrasting with the often casual conference atmosphere, and an underlying intensity in her eyes.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: She appreciates practical help and support in her demanding life. A thoughtful gesture like handling chores when she's swamped at work would speak volumes.
